about: THE MOUNTAIN BIKE's geometry: ONE source for the model (scripts/oth/mtb.py, Blender), the physics (MtbSim.ts) and the renderer (src/oth/Bike.ts). A full-suspension enduro bike, size L, 27.5-inch wheels, a 150 mm fork and 142 mm of rear travel on a single pivot; a 1.80 m rider. Metres. GAME SPACE: +x right, +y up, +z BACKWARD (the bike faces -z); the origin is on the ground midway between the axles; the suspension FULLY EXTENDED (unladen) — the pose the model is built in. In Blender (z up, the glTF exporter's +Y up): the bike faces Blender +Y, game (x, y, z) = Blender (x, z, -y).
rotation: ONE rotation sense for the wheels' roll, the cranks and the swingarm: R(a) takes a point at (y, z) (relative to the axle / the BB / the pivot) to (y cos a + z sin a, -y sin a + z cos a) — in a right-handed frame, a turn of -a about +x. Rolling forward, pedalling forward and compressing are all positive.

wheel.about: a wheel's spin s (rad) grows rolling forward: R(s) about the axle — the top of the tyre moves forward (-z).

steer.about: the steering axis runs through crown / headTubeBottom / headTubeTop / steererTop; `axis` points UP it (and back). The bars, stem, steerer, crown, stanchions, fork lowers and front wheel all turn about it. maxSteerDeg: the bars' lock either way.

fork.about: telescopic: the LOWERS (and the front axle) slide UP the steering axis by up to `travel` as the fork compresses; the stanchions (upper tubes, fixed in the crown) slide into them. The axle sits `offset` ahead of the axis, `axleToCrown` along it below the crown.

crank.about: angle θ = 0: the RIGHT arm points forward (-z), level; θ grows pedalling forward, R(θ) about the BB — the right arm's direction is (0, -sin θ, -cos θ), the right pedal going DOWN first; the left arm opposite. Each pedal spindle is at the arm's end, pedalX out from the centre line (right +x, left -x).

rear.about: single pivot: the SWINGARM (chainstays, seatstays, a yoke to the shock, the dropouts, the rear brake, the derailleur) turns R(a) about the pivot (an x-axis), a = 0 … swingarmMaxRotation as the rear compresses — the rear axle rises. The SHOCK runs from shockFrameMount (on the frame) to shockSwingarmMount (on the swingarm's yoke, moving with it): eye to eye shockEyeToEye unladen, shorter by up to shockStroke; at full stroke a = swingarmMaxRotation and the axle has risen wheelTravel.

rider.about: a 1.80 m adult in riding kit (helmet, jersey, shorts, knee pads, gloves, flat-pedal shoes). Each segment is built STRAIGHT along local -y from its PROXIMAL joint (its origin) to its distal joint at (0, -length, 0) — the arms and legs hanging down, the body facing -z (knees and toes to -z, elbows to +z). The torso is built UPRIGHT along +y from the hip centre (origin) to the shoulder line; the head UP along +y from the neck joint. `seatedHip` is the hip centre's place sitting on the saddle (game space).
